adopt: Point it at one RTSP camera, enable it, and read back a one-line description of each event.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
Home cameras record to someone else's servers, keep footage on their terms, and tell you "motion detected" forty times a day without saying what moved.

Install
builds in-tree -- not on PyPI yet; `pip install awcams` 404s today

Commands
  awcams

Quick start
  pip install -e. # recording, events, API
  pip install -e ".[vision]" # + one-line summaries through a local vision model
synopsis: Private camera recording and one-line event summaries, on storage you own.
